title: Microsoft Purview: Azure PST Import to Exchange Online mailboxes
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout, prerequisites and PowerShell-only workflow match Microsoft's supplied notice and roadmap. The Azure role-assignment instructions, published bulk-import licence rights and Blob Storage meters are supported; feature-specific documentation gaps remain appropriately qualified.
